lines.text: You reach out to grab the tie... but what's this? Radiating chest pain! Fear washes over you.
Oh no, it's happening again. You didn't catch it and now there's numbness in half your chest.
Oh no, it's happening again. You didn't catch it and now there's numbness in your left arm, plus half your chest.
You reach out to grab the tie... but what's this? Diffuse, radiating chest pain! Doom comes over you.
You swoop up and catch the tie... Snap! It's released from the blade.
As you blow this joint -- behind you a whiny voice shouts:

That's true, yes. And it's worrying. But let's not *fixate* on it. Look at that stupid bartender instead -- he has no idea what's going on! You and your fuck-you-fingers floating in the air. Barkeep's got his mouth agape like an idiot. You showed him.
Everything goes dark.
One moment you're running like the wind, then you've suddenly turned around and are giving him the finger. Furiously, with both hands. Why?!
No. You have sustained a trauma to your lower neck. In addition, you have strained your left trapezius muscle. Pain surges down your back when you move.
An acrobatic manoeuvre would solve this situation. Nothing can go wrong with a good *manoeuvre*.
It *seems* unclimbable, cause the ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...
Secret path, secret path, secret path!
Even Cuno thinks it's unclimbable, cause the ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...
It seems doable. The kids' ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...
This is a cool moment. It needs a cool thing to be said.
You need to look into these shacks. Especially hers.
Under carts, boats, in little boxes. It's not hard to find.
She may simply have kept the equipment elsewhere.
Some kind of foul play might be afoot. Theft?
Be careful where you tread in the reeds. Some less conscientious researchers may have left their traps out there -- armed, hidden.
Teenagers skulking around. Gang-members looking for a hole in the Union's defences? Maybe Ruby too, but she wouldn't be able to tell from here.
Damn! Your feet thought we got away!
How many times do I have to tell you about the trash bin idea?! Let's get climbing already! Into trash bins!
You could try climbing into that trash bin in the yard, hobocop style...
You could try climbing into that trash bin in the yard, hobocop style... after you've gotten open the lid.
You do realize you can just go into the kitchen at 13:00? No need for superstar charm or Sam Bo style antics here.
Forgetting was merely a matter of convenience -- very clever!
Forgetting was merely a matter of convenience -- very clever!
And this guy too.
It explains everything. All the running around. The jumping. The *bicep girth*.
Good thing she's didn't say PARTY EYES loud, her mother's nearby...
Did someone say *sneak around in the cellar*? We should do that.
Check out the pose -- rigid as a stick. He couldn't even wipe his own ass. You don't want to be like that.
You swear you feel the profit margins reflecting off Germaine Egg Head's giant smile.
These guys will never catch him. You will never catch him. There's nothing to do.
But be easy about it. Communists have been known to charge when startled.
The lieutenant's right. It's sort of amazing how un-subtly you're sniffing the air around you, almost like you're *trying* to call attention to yourself.
Are they being sarcastic? You feel like you're caught in some elaborate joke labyrinth, but it's impossible to see your way through.
He is neither of those, of course. He is simply a poor student, putting on airs. Also, he doesn't have the shoulders to fill out such a jacket.
Probably not, is the answer. Which isn't to say it isn't *sometimes* still useful.
The energy in the room has shifted ever so slightly in your favour. They're afraid they've somehow *embarrassed* themselves in front of you.
Watch out. You call yourself a communist and yet you've been accumulating a *suspiciously* large share of capital in just the last few days. It's almost certainly distorting your thinking.
In another life, you might've made a fine seafaring man. Who knows, you may become one yet.
Just a moment -- could this be the former owner of a certain jacket you 'acquired' recently?
Delivered with the smug assurance of a schoolboy reciting a maxim he's committed to memory.
You've accrued a modest account balance over the last few days, but probably not enough to warp your thinking *too* much.
His "experience" with these matters is painfully limited, not that he realises it.
Nothing to fear. Judging from your account balance, you should be thinking *extremely* clearly.
It's not that the boundary between sarcasm and sincerity is porous with these two, it's that they actually seem to *overlap*, as though one is meant to conceal the other.
It looks better on you, anyway. He never had the shoulders for it.
The lieutenant's right. It's sort of amazing how *un-subtly* you're sniffing the air around you, almost like you're *trying* to call attention to yourself.
Obviously because it's *cool* to drop random phrases in foreign languages.
Absolute nonsense. Whoever wrote this has clearly never built a successful business before.
Perhaps they've overestimated the market demand for this kind of *commentary*.
No advertisements, you notice. So who's funding this *radical commentary*?
A little self-dealing?
You're reminded of something people used to say, that Revachol West is poor, but *sexy poor*.
You can't help but feel that *sabre* you picked up might just give this old king a little more panache *and* better reception!
How could you be alone? You're a *star*, man. You've got an *entourage* and adoring fans wherever you go...
She needs to see *you*, down here. That's the only way she'll really *get* what you're about.
That sounds *much* better than the 5,500 reál the RCM calls a 'salary.'
No problem at all. You've already teleported up *way* greater heights.
*One* coin. The first of many. Imagine so many coins you're going to need to hire someone to help you manage all your wealth.

By all accounts this place should be *swarming* with artist-types. It's just a matter of time until you meet one. Look for squats and cheap rentals, we might even chance upon a *political artivist* here.
Go and support her like the state never could. Everyone must know that you're a big fucking shark around here!
It should be the other way around. Old mitred money showing up at your doorstep, begging for a slice of cake.
And then what? Join the ranks of blue-collar criminals?
Don't listen to this fool. It's not about the artists, it's about the *buyers*. You can't hang 'vapour-porn' in the foyer of your chalet.
What's up? I'm worried about what's *down*, broke boy. I'm talking about your severe lack of money.
No, you don't! You just keep muttering about your 'economic self-interest' and not doing anything about it. Yeah, I heard you back there. What the hell was that?!
No, you need something *real*, something you can hold on to with all your claws and teeth.
What? No, screw that shit-show. You're at the centre of this one. Come on down, contestant, you're about to make some *money*.
Stop grumbling, it's time to move. Are you in or are you out?
No, don't you ever be sorry. You think the Salzneben Report's Top 500 has 'sorry' in their vocabulary? Think again. That's a loser's mindset.
Music is a pet project, not a viable business scheme. Let's return to it once you've set up your estate.
Oh, it can. But first you need to *enter* the market. Right now you're as good as Samir Loisir eating dirt in Gurdi's immense network of mines.
Once we've brought in the millions you can be a tree log for all I care, but first we've got to work on increasing your net worth.
Exactly. Not making money when you're asleep, are you? If you wanna be rich you better work until your fingers bleed. You can sleep when you die.
Hey, money-mouth. Eendracht. The impeccable hustler-provider of the seventh generation. It's showtime with Savvy!

But Savvy's got your back. Savvy's going to book you a charter flight with eighty birds of prey on board, to a land where the streets are paved with krugerrands and fixed-income securities. You'll try again, but this time with *money*. You'll win her back.
That's right! It's time to stop muttering about your 'economic self-interest' and actually do something about it. Yeah, I heard you back there. What the hell was that?!
Good, good, gotta spread the gospel. But talk alone doesn't bring in the cash. It's time for step two.
Suit yourself and your middle-class ways -- Savvy doesn't need you, Savvy's got his own *entourage*.
Not unless you have thousands of them stuffed away in secret.
Listen, if you really want to make it in the big leagues, you need to *re-conceptualize* your entire portfolio. Collecting tare and moaning about taxes is not going to cut it.
We're getting somewhere. But what project? And what's the ROI?
The spirit of ultraliberalism. Your charm, your spin, your winning hand.

Those guys? They're all financially illiterate. Only Savvy here knows how to *dazzle* and *embezzle* money out of investors' pockets with the acrobatic prowess of a four-time gold medallist in the Samaran Gymnastic Summer Games.
Are you in?
Stop thinking of it that way. It's not a 'painting', it's a 'highly collectible and irreproducible asset'. So, know any local artists with assets to sell?
He's also twelve. We don't want to attract the attention of tax collectors by dabbling in unnecessary child-labour.
Go and support them like the state never could. Everyone must know that you're a big fucking shark around here!

Attaboy, welcome to the final grind! Here we operate with money on a *much* higher level than the ordinary citizen, we feed it back into the machine. Stop saving, start spending -- become a *patron*...
Don't be silly, the art market isn't about art, it's about gate-keeping, speculative bidding, and showboating.
Superstar talk? Good one, hustler, gotta keep the dream alive. But it's not really showing up in your net worth yet, is it? And it's what -- day two, three, four?
You need to become a MILLIONAIRE. Now, how do you become a MILLIONAIRE?
You're right. She has the poise of a struggling artist. Very *tangible*. You can *feel* the poverty on her. Plus, she has paint.
You will. I'm here to make your life better. They call me the Man-About-Town. Gilded Heart-Throb. Master of Money.
Of course you don't. You've never even been *close* to a sum with more than three zeros. Let's face it, you've been on a years-long losing streak...
Let's start by getting you into the lucrative art market to diversify your assets and increase your ROI. Speaking of which, know any artists?
Yeah, swindle-father. Papa-preneur. Look, this is serious. No time for distractions. It's time to make *money*. Lots of it.
Brilliant, catastrophes are *prime time* for money-makers. But you're not really reaping any benefits yet, are you? No shorting, no shameless speculation...

Did Ilona Wihuri-Vilakone blame ghosts? How about Admiral Gustav Lestock? Samir Loisir grew up in the coal mines of Gurdi eating dirt, and he still managed to make FIFTY-FIVE BILLION REÁL in his lifetime. So stop with the excuses.

Do you see any stock markets in Martinaise? No? That's because for those living in the outskirts, the market is *nothing*. Just ghost numbers flicking through time. A spectral sport they're not invited to play.
There! On that balcony. Do you see it? It's an artist!
What you need to do is lure them in with a strong one-liner -- get them on your side before you've even finished a sentence. Show us what you've got -- pretend you're facing the SKULL-girl!
A streak of individuality? As you wish...
A streak of individuality. As you wish...
Holy-moly, are we being arrested here?! Only tax inspectors and debt collectors speak like that. You don't want to start your business relationship with the wrong vibe.
Mamma mia, if this isn't the Top Seller in La Delta! Everyone knew you'd eventually get it right...
The dishevelled hair, cheap clothes, slumping posture that suggests an unearned sense of superiority...
There! Right in front of you. Do you see it?
Artistos are known to *repel* wealth. It bounces off their skin like rubber. The moment a reasonable business proposal enters their periphery, they go and get 'political'.
There! Right in front of you. Do you see it? It's an artist!
Straight into a bullring with no prep talk? No-no-no. It's your first sales negotiation, Savvy's gotta give you the do-s and don't-s.
Okay then, off you go! Let's see what you've got.
What is this, a dating agency? Are you looking for a Pretty Young Thing to sponsor? Never mix business and pleasure -- *never*.
There! On that balcony. Do you see it?
What you need to do is lure them in with a strong one-liner -- get them on your side before you've even finished a sentence. Show us what you've got -- pretend you're facing the girl!
Seems to be one of those conceptual types... not good. If we proceed cautiously we might get something tangible out of her.
The *artisto*. Now hold up, you can't go into a bullring without a prep talk. It's baby's first sales negotiation after all! Savvy's gotta give you the do-s and don't-s.
Mamma mia, if this isn't the Top Seller in La Delta! No one expected you to nail this on the *first* try -- *congratulazioni*!
It's all there if you know how to read people. Commanders of the streets like me have it down to a tee. I'll teach you. Listen up...
Boring... BORING... Yawning my jaw off here... Next!
Yes, this seems to be one of those *conceptual* types... not good. If we proceed cautiously we might get something tangible out of her.
See that massive container there, held up by that humongous crane? That's it! We need to get that box of treasures down. Try using that control panel over there.
There! In that container you moved. There's *something* rich in there. We've got to get inside.
The ominous hum of a preposterously affluent individual... It seems to be coming from above us.
No, not the rain -- the ominous hum of a *preposterously affluent individual*... It seems to be coming from above us.
No, not the snow -- the ominous hum of a *preposterously affluent individual*... It seems to be coming from above us.
Opening the door? C'mon, I shouldn't have to tell you that. Get me up close and I'll show you how it's done.
No 'buts', I want to see your *can-do* attitude shine this time. Get moving!
*Slow down*? We don't have time to slow down -- it's *crunch time*! Get your ass moving and control that crane! We've got sales to make.
Psst, hear that?
Yes, I'm sure. *Someone* here has assets stacked away in OFCs. Look up.
Great *work* ethic, friend. No one should be scared to get their hands dirty on the road to brilliant *success*.
Then it's time to show you how a *master* does it. No lock survives a round with Savvy. Get me up close.
Here we are. Whoever is in there definitely has money, so let's convince them to part with it for our *exclusive* piece of art.
Tax havens, OFCs, Sinks, Conduits, *heavens*... Get with the terms, hustler-boy. Now look up!

I know business-speak when I see it. This is an official, legitimate, checked-by-the-board certificate. You really are a stock market big-boy now. Sound the money klaxon and bring out the hustle-clowns -- they dance for us today!
Spoken like a true hustler. We have a long way to go -- your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Yes, who are you talking about?
Good -- take no responsibility for this disaster. It was supposed to *promote* you, not make people fear you.
Honest. Maybe even *too* honest... Didn't we talk about giving back to the community?
Beauty doesn't cut it. We have a long way to go -- your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
An Art Cop? No. You're a hustler -- and you've got a long way to go. Your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Maybe... But we still have a long way to go -- your net worth is *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Still keeping the superstar dream alive...
An Apocalypse Cop? No. You're a hustler -- and you've got a long way to go. Your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Yes, who are you talking about?
Come on, we've stood here long enough. And money doesn't sleep.
No, the free market demands something much more PR-friendly than what Idiot Doom Spiral has done here.

Ask the man. Ask around. The doors of good taste are open to you. Be in vogue.
Boots -- black in colour, crafted of hardened leather, if you had to guess. They look sturdy and stable, useful in rugged environments.
I stand corrected.

As he does, he stomps his foot on the pavement and... stop everything! Look at that sweet pair of boots on his feet! They would absolutely complement your *soul*, would let your style fly even higher!
Geez, live a little. At least give things a try. It's just boots. A set of sweet, stylish boots.
Blazing his own trail, being his own man... not exactly your typical communist spiel.
Overwhelm them with moves. Try to have the most moves going on.
Now's the time for a SPIN KICK! He expects the one-two, not the one-three-sixty!
Try the jump? Up there, on the roof! It'll be worth it. Else there is little choice but to figure out a way to deal with the man...
Try the jump? Up there, on the roof! It'll be worth it. Else there is little choice but to figure out a way to deal with the man...
You can. It's very *asinine*.
Why are you bothering with this tiresome woman -- just open the curtains while she's distracted!
The curtains do seem *frail* suddenly. Not robust enough to contain a slippery darkness.
A faint slice of light from the curtains reveals a doorway in the back, draped in cage-like polyhedrons. They are all made of fish heads and tiny animal bones; it looks like a small graveyard...
The room behind them is dim... You can only discern shadowy silhouettes of *things* there, crouching in the dark like monsters in a child's bedroom.
No, they're at a disco. Getting down. Stupid disco dancing teenagers.
Cool. Let's do this swindle. This *tare* swindle.
You should go over and ask him about paying for those sneakers with your net worth.
Dedicated! Victorious! Sporty! These *FALN* sneakers are a must-have for a track-and-field legend.
Speaking of luxury, you should go over and ask about paying for those sneakers with your net worth.
Stylish shades, huh? They'd be even more stylish if you paid for them with net worth. Go over and ask him.
How about some premium-class service over here? Like paying with net worth. Go over and ask him if you can do that.
If he really wants to save the economy he'd let you pay with net worth. Go over and ask him if you can
You now proudly own a primer book for small children which, to be honest, barely cost anything.
Slowly, you move your hand towards the small book. Before you even can reach it, you're interrupted:
You peek at the storekeep, waiting for her to be distracted. When she's not looking, you deftly swipe the small booklet off the shelf and stuff it in your pocket.
You could try climbing into that trash bin in the yard, hobocop style... after you've gotten open the lid.
You could try climbing into that trash bin in the yard, hobocop style...
Hey, remember that trash bin idea...? Time to get climbing!
Have you made all the necessary preparations? Closed all your accounts?
Wasn't *easy* getting that giant novelty cheque from Evrart. Took some ingenuity to get into the harbour, but you got in -- and you *took* that bribe as hard as any cop's taken it.
That's right. You work harder than *anyone*, you almost rode yourself to the grave and you're still practically a *hobo* -- why is that?
You didn't log that in as a donation either -- you don't log any of that shit in, you're a straight rider.
Oh yeah! Like a horse. A work horse. For hard work.
It ain't easy, but you *do* it. Day in and day out. You didn't make the rules but you won't lose! You're a cop and a sprinter and a money printer.
That's just what it's like -- life and death. But you got *gills* on your side, baby, got those black papers with the faces of the innocences on them -- you bring in the Franconegros and the Solas.
NINETY-EIGHT PERCENT OF ALL YOUR MONEY.

Every time you wipe your ass! They got their direct and their *indirect modes of taxation*: sales tax, excise duty, extraction tax, alimony, one tax that doesn't even have a name! Plus there's the stuff *people in other countries* pay for, that makes them ask for more money from *you* here. Total tax duties add up to...
Wow, you work *hard*.
Oh yeah, you took that bribe *hard*. You're a killa'.
He did, yes he did. And you took it. Took it and put in in your pocket. Ka-ching, baby doll. Officer Hustle riding shotgun.
The Garte-man has set himself up one of those self replicating money-structures. You should *learn* from it. Don't play the victim. Think, hustler. Think with your head.
Here you go, hustler, fight the righteous fight! Free the people. Keep it real. Keep it street. Keep foaming at the mouth *furiously* on the tax issue!
Oh, yes. You hustle. You're a provider. It's tough out there, but you keep it real and provide...
Oh, you do. You *make* money. You got gills, baby, meaning those black papers with the faces of the innocences on them. You bring in the Franconegros and the Solas.
Get outta here! You're a pauper! You work harder than *anyone*, almost rode yourself to the grave and you're still practically a *hobo* -- why is that?
That's right! One-hundred percent. Fucking G-man's got his jam-covered sticky-fingers in your pocket, stealing from you every time you buy, sell, walk, talk, fart, so much as sneeze!
That is the sign of a hustler who never gives up. The world is harsh and people are evil -- you didn't make it that way. And you won't let it break you. You *ride*.
...are you *rich*?
Here you go, hustler, fight the righteous fight! Free the people. Keep it real. Keep it street. Keep foaming at the mouth *furiously* on the tax issue!
Because of the TAXES. G-man's got his jam-covered sticky-fingers in your pocket, stealing from you every time you buy, sell, walk, talk, fart, so much as sneeze!
It's *all* about the tax issue, hustler. No other problem in the world is as pressing as top-marginal tax rates, and don't you fucking forget it.
Yeah, ain't it cool, rider?! Ain't it street?
I know you're in a hurry, sir -- off to work really hard, as always -- I just need *one* moment of your time to discuss how hard you hustle.
Look at yourself, you're a human pedometer! You must have walked 200,000 steps down cracked asphalt, mosaic, sand, and linoleum after you re-emerged.
A little? You *make* money. You got gills, baby, got those black papers with the faces of the innocences on them. You bring in the Franconegros and the Solas.
What are you, a racist? Don't be a racist! Be a cool immigrant ultraliberal free market advocate! Ride or die, keep it street!
What are you not sure about?! They're *milking* your nipples till they bleed. Can't you see? Aren't you *sick and tired* of having bloody nipples?
Look, the immigrants are cool. The immigrants play *cool* music. Everyone likes them. Especially the women. Don't hate on the immigrants. They've got nothing to do with you living under a boat.
Yeah, you're in the sales business. Shake 'em for shit and then pawn it off, *law officer*-style.
Boohoo, *the system is broken*. *The establishment is keeping me down...* That's not the fuck-yeah attitude you're used to, what is this? Why are you so poor?
Can't say that -- you *shook* him. You're a killer. A shark.

Sure, sure. And has it been easy? Is life easy? Have you *not* gone into cardiac arrest? Are you *not* about to have an anxiety attack or shoot yourself in the mouth? But you still hustle 24/7, ride or die. Now, ask yourself...

You and I both, but they got those *indirect modes of taxation*. Sales tax, excise duty, extraction tax, this tax that doesn't even have a name -- plus there's the stuff *people in other countries* pay for, that makes them ask for more money from *you* here! The Gossamer State's a myth. In total the Coalition Government is taking...
Let not failure ensnare you any further, beautiful pixie girl! Be an acrobat! A prancing faerie queen!
Return without the lieutenant -- for this? Your balance organ thinks it's a waste of time.
A full suit of armour can't be too agile. You can shift direction faster than he can.
It's sunken too deep. There is no access ramp to the coast.
